edtrackai-ship-ready-skills-launch-secur.description: Quick pre-launch security check for Next.js + Supabase + Stripe apps. Finds public tables without row level security, service-role or secret keys reaching client code (NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables, 'use client' files), and Stripe webhook handlers without constructEvent signature verification. Use when the user asks for a launch, ship or go-live security check, or a quick security pass on a Supabase/Stripe app.

edtrackai-ship-ready-skills-stripe-webho.description: Review Next.js Stripe webhook route handlers for missing signature verification, JSON parsed before verification, missing or non-status-aware idempotency on event.id (pending/completed), unsafe reprocessing of pending events, and billing periods read from items.data[0]. Use when the user asks to review a Stripe webhook, idempotency, duplicate events, or payments before launch.

edtrackai-ship-ready-skills-supabase-gra.description: Check Supabase migrations for the security side of the 30 Oct 2026 Data API grants change (Supabase's changelog schedules it) - GRANT ALL or write grants to anon, grants on tables with RLS off, policies whose role has no grant (42501), grants with no policy, SECURITY DEFINER functions anon can execute, default privileges that still auto-grant, and the local auto_expose_new_tables setting. Use when the user asks about Supabase grants, a 42501 permission-denied error, the 30 October change, or whether a GRANT fix is safe.

edtrackai-ship-ready-skills-supabase-rls.description: Review Supabase SQL migrations for row level security gaps and missing or blanket Data API grants (tables without RLS, using (true) write policies, anon write policies, security definer functions without search_path, public tables with no explicit GRANT (Supabase's changelog schedules a grants change for 30 Oct 2026), blanket grants to anon/authenticated). Use when the user asks to review RLS, Supabase policies, grants, a 42501 error, or database security before launch.

edtrackai-ship-ready-skills-unthrottled-.description: Find Next.js API routes that call OpenAI, Anthropic or the Vercel AI SDK, or create a Stripe Checkout Session, with no rate limiter. Use when the user asks about rate limiting, AI cost per user, surprise API bills, refresh loops at checkout, or abuse protection before launch.
